Professional Summary

Techno-Functional Business Analyst with 6+ years of experience in digital transformation and cross-border payments within the banking domain. Proven track record in SWIFT MT/MX, SEPA, ISO 20022, API integration, and retail banking system migrations. Skilled at translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions within Agile/Scrum environments. Hands-on expertise in microservices, REST APIs, SQL, stakeholder management, and end-to-end requirement lifecycle from BRD/FRD through UAT. Exposure to compliance frameworks including KYC/AML processes and regulatory payment rails (FedNow, Fedwire, ACH, CHAPS, Target2).

Core Competencies

Business Analysis & Requirements: Stakeholder Management | Requirement Elicitation | BRD / FRD | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria | Gap Analysis | Field-Level Mapping | Root Cause Analysis

Technology & Tools: REST APIs | Microservices Architecture | SQL | XML | JSON | HTTP Methods (GET/POST/PUT) | Process Flow Diagrams | Postman / Swagger | ETL Concepts

Agile & Collaboration: Sprint Planning | Backlog Grooming | Daily Standup | SIT / UAT Testing | JIRA | Confluence | Figma | Lucid chart | Draw.io | Excel | PowerPoint
